note: Both sets correctly capture the 40W/9W/7W light-output equivalence, the T24 high-efficacy requirement for HARVEST HOME fixtures, and the vacancy-sensor dimming-bypass requirement with proper conditions and supporting quotes. Set A adds one extra claim that is merely a duplicate of its own T24 requirement claim (without conditions), making it more redundant than Set B. Because Set B carries fewer trivial duplicate claims while keeping the same correct content, it is slightly better.
